messages:
Maya R.: Quick heads-up — product launch scheduled 2024-04-03. Need final SEO + technical tasks prioritized. I'll list must-haves. tl;dr: keywords, schema for product & docs, internal linking map, 301 redirects for beta pages, canonical & hreflang check, sitemap update. Who can own what?

Sam G.: I can drive keyword clusters & messaging. High-priority target keyword groups: 
- low-latency LLM inference
- cost-efficient inference platform
- dedicated GPU inference
- private VPC model serving
We should map blog + benchmark narratives to these clusters rather than one-off posts.

Liam T.: I'll take schema + technical validations. Plan: add SoftwareApplication schema on product landing, Organization + ContactPoint, FAQ schema for launch FAQs, and Product/Service markup where sensible. Need examples and final URLs to patch into templates.

Priya K.: I'll own internal linking and canonical strategy across docs + blog. My approach: create a small hub page (/inference-ops) that links out to: product landing, dedicated, private, benchmarks, webinar landing. Use descriptive anchor text like "Redwood Dedicated inference", "LLM serving latency benchmarks". That hub will also be target for PRs from the launch posts.

Sam G.: Also we need benchmark narrative pages to be canonical pages (not hidden behind JS). Prefer server-rendered summary + 1-2 deep-dive subpages. Keywords + H2s should match cluster terms.

Liam T.: Redirects: we have old beta paths and a handful of old marketing pages to 301. Example redirect rules (Netlify style) that I will submit to infra: 
```
/beta/inference    /product/dedicated   301
/beta/overview     /product             301
/old-webinar       /events/webinar-2024-04-10 301
/docs/v0/*         /docs/v1/:splat      301
```
We'll also add canonical tags to docs/v1 pages.

Priya K.: For internal linking, I'll produce a CSV of source -> target -> anchor text by EOD Fri. Prioritized sources: blog launch post, benchmarks, docs overview, webinar page.

Maya R.: Owners and deadlines: Keywords + messaging (Sam) — draft by Mar 25. Schema + redirects (Liam) — PR by Mar 26. Internal linking map + launch posts (Priya) — drafts by Mar 27. Final QA + Search Console test (SEO Bot + Liam) — Mar 28 COB.

SEO Bot: I will run a staging scan once redirects and schema are merged. Checklist I will validate: sitemap.xml updated, robots.txt unchanged (allow), canonical points to final URL, schema passes Rich Results test, server-side render for key pages, 200s for Googlebot UA.

Liam T.: One technical note: implement structured data with JSON-LD in the head, not inline microdata. For the FAQ schema, ensure Q/A content is visible on the page (no hidden JS rendering), otherwise rich results will fail.

Sam G.: We should also add breadcrumb schema on deep pages and set up internal search landing signals to route high-intent queries to pricing/dedicated pages.

Priya K.: Redirect QA: we'll use curl checks in CI and a small Playwright smoke test to ensure links land with 301 and final pages render. I'll add tests to the marketing repo. Example curl: `curl -I https://redwood.example/beta/inference` should return `HTTP/2 301` and Location header.

Maya R.: Good. Also note inbound lead routing: webinar page needs hidden form field `source=webinar_launch_2024` and redirect to /thank-you?src=webinar so sales can tag leads. Priya, can you add?

Priya K.: Yep — the webinar form will include hidden utm and source fields and we’ll push to Marketo via the form endpoint. I'll coordinate with Sales ops for the lead assignment rules.

Sam G.: Last item: canonical/hreflang — we have EU region pages. Liam, can you run a quick audit for hreflang tags so we don't duplicate content across regions?

Liam T.: Will do. Plan: check existing hreflang map, ensure canonical points to region-specific landing when appropriate, otherwise point to global canonical.

Maya R.: Perfect. Let's reconvene Tue morning for a short pre-launch sync. If anyone hits blockers, ping #eng-frontend for redirects/infra. :rocket:
